## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that the current BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON engine (as of v15.3) achieves edge_capture >= 771 on the J anchor days when evaluated with walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation, with <±20% deviation from BS-sim P&L on the top 3 J days.

## Mechanism

No mechanism change; this candidate is a validation gate that requires the engine to pass walk-forward OOS test (edge_capture >= 771) and real-fills validation on 4/29, 5/01, 5/04 showing <±20% deviation from BS-sim P&L. The engine remains unchanged; we are only adding a pre-merge gate that mandates these tests.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per OP-20).
2. **Sample bias:** We propose to use the full 16-month OPRA dataset (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) for walk-forward OOS, with a 80/20 time split (first 80% train, last 20% test) to avoid look-ahead bias. Overfit risk is mitigated by requiring WF >= 0.70 and sub-window stability.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window to be performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA validation on top 3 J days to be performed).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: potential loss on a loser day exceeding -$260 (5/05) or -$300 (5/06) if engine fails to skip; max drawdown scenario: consecutive loser days could exceed -$500; blow-up scenario: engine taking all loser days at full loss could yield edge_capture negative.
6. **Concentration:** If top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest.

## Pre-merge gate

Gym validators must pass, walk-forward OOS edge_capture >= 771 with WF ratio >= 0.70, real-fills on top 3 J days showing <±20% deviation from BS-sim P&L, and anchor no-regression (engine must take all 3 winner days and skip or lose less on loser days).

This candidate does not change the engine; it is a validation gate. It complements all existing candidates by providing a rigorous OOS and real-fills check. It does not conflict with any candidate.
